title: Add a single end-to-end walkthrough page and link it from page 1
story: As a sceptical engineer, I want one concrete walkthrough from user intent to governed outcome so I can see how DaemonCore changes the user experience beyond orchestration tools.
description: Create a /daemon/walkthrough page that shows a single scenario (code review) with explicit stages: intent → preflight classification → action proposal shape → MAX bus routing → template constrained result → violation example → prompt injection note. Link it from homepage and /daemon landing.
acceptance_criteria: Walkthrough is one scenario only (code review) and fits on a single page.
Each stage is clearly labelled and uses concise, skimmable sections.
Includes one violation example and one prompt injection example with honest V1 limitations.
Does not reveal internal confidential details; uses public-safe terms already used on site (MAX bus, templates, action protocol).
Links added from homepage and /daemon index.
